summary: This is a project planning document that outlines the goals, technology choices, feedback mechanisms, and timeline for launching a software product. The team plans to build an MVP using Next.js and Tailwind with AI capabilities, gather user feedback every two weeks, and scale through Q2 and Q3.

explanations.6: The == marks around 'user feedback' are highlighting syntax in Quarto markdown—it's just emphasizing that user feedback collection is a key goal.
explanations.11: Next.js is a React framework for building web applications, and Tailwind is a utility-first CSS framework for styling; they're listing the two main frontend technologies.
explanations.12: This is noting that the product will use OpenAI's API to provide AI features to users.
explanations.14: PostgreSQL is the database system they've chosen to store application data.
